newsitem.title: GERMANY: German June steel production shows clear rise.
newsitem.headline: German June steel production shows clear rise.

text.p: German steel production rose markedly in June in both west and east Germany, the Federal Statistics Office said on Monday.

For June, the office reported pan-German raw iron output rose 12.8 percent to 2,56 million tonnes, raw steel output rose 15.3 percent to 3.81 million tonnes and hot-rolled production increased 15.4 percent to 3.18 million tonnes.
West Germany's June output of raw steel rose 16.4 percent to 3.35 million tonnes and hot-rolled production increased 16 percent to 2,87 million tonnes.
East Germany's June output of raw steel 7.6 percent to 460,000 tonnes and hot-rolled production rose 9.9 percent to 310,000 tonnes.
The office provided no figures for west and east German raw iron production.

As previously announced, pan-German output of raw iron in the first half of 1997 rose 11.3 percent to 15.07 million tonnes. First-half raw steel production rose 12.6 percent to 22.01 million tonnes and output of hot-rolled products increased 11.7 percent to 17.96 million tonnes.
West German raw steel output for the first half rose 14 percent ot 19.47 million tonnes. Hot-rolled production increased 11 percent to 16.09 million tonnes.
In the same period, east German raw steel output climbed 3.5 percent to 2.54 million tonnes. Hot-rolled produciton rose 18.2 percent to 1.87 million tonnes.
